property.name: SupportsAnisotropy
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports anisotropic filtering.

property.name: SupportsColorPerspective
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device iterates colors perspective correctly.

property.name: SupportsDepthBias
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports legacy depth bias.

property.name: SupportsDepthBufferLessHsr
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can perform hidden-surface removal (HSR) without requiring the application to sort polygons and without requiring the allocation of a depth buffer.
property.remarks: This leaves more video memory for textures. The method used to perform HSR is hardware-dependent and is transparent to the application. Z-bufferless HSR is performed if no depth-buffer surface is associated with the rendering-target surface and the depth-buffer comparison test is enabled (that is, when the state value associated with the DepthBufferEnable is true).

property.name: SupportsDepthBufferTest
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can perform depth-test operations.
property.remarks: This effectively renders a primitive and indicates whether any depth pixels have been rendered.

property.name: SupportsDepthFog
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports depth-based fog.

property.name: SupportsFogRange
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports range-based fog.
property.remarks: In range-based fog, the distance of an object from the viewer is used to compute fog effects, not the depth of the object (that is, the z-coordinate) in the scene.

property.name: SupportsFogTable
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device calculates the fog value by referring to a lookup table containing fog values that are indexed to the depth of a given pixel.

property.name: SupportsFogVertex
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device calculates the fog value during the lighting operation and interpolates the fog value during rasterization.

property.name: SupportsMipMapLevelOfDetailBias
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports level-of-detail bias adjustments.
property.remarks: These bias adjustments enable an application to make a mipmap appear crisper or less sharp than it normally would.

property.name: SupportsMultisampleToggle
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports toggling multisampling on and off.

property.name: SupportsScissorTest
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports scissor test.

property.name: SupportsSlopeScaleDepthBias
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device performs true slope-scale based depth bias.
property.remarks: This is in contrast to the legacy-style depth bias.

property.name: SupportsWFog
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports w-based fog.
property.remarks: W-based fog is used when a perspective projection matrix is specified, but affine projections still use z-based fog. The system considers a projection matrix that contains a nonzero value in the [3][4] element to be a perspective projection matrix.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.

overload.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.
